name: somatic-variant-calling
description: Call somatic mutations from tumor-normal paired samples or tumor-only samples. GATK Mutect2 uses a local assembly approach similar to HaplotypeCaller but models somatic allele fractions (potentially below 50%) and filters germline variants using a panel of normals and population allele frequency databases. Key parameters: minimum allele fraction for detection, contamination estimation, and orientation bias artifact filtering.
